name: Google Compute Engine Free Tier
free_limit: One non-preemptible e2-micro VM-month (aggregate hours), 30 GB-months standard persistent disk and 1 GB eligible outbound data/month
watch_out: Free e2-micro usage only in us-west1, us-central1 or us-east1. The VM allowance is pooled by running hours across those regions, not one free VM in every region. GPUs/TPUs, other disk types, excess egress, IP addresses and other billable resources are not covered. An active Cloud Billing account is required.
